name: Running Shoes
description: Hold B to walk faster, at a speed you pick: x1.5, x2, x3 or x4. Rides the engine's own movement.speed hook, whose comment names running shoes as the reason it exists. A run can leave a trail behind you -- dust, flames or lightning -- and, if you switch them on, CUT the tall grass it crosses one clod at a time, the way the CUT move does, or run through it without meeting anything. Optional boosts for the bicycle and for surfing. Everything past the speed itself is a row you turn on.
